written_from_parent_concept.parent: google_compute_global_vm_extension_policy (rollout plans are real, but only documented as part of how global VM extension policies roll out changes)

intros.sourcing_notes: 71 of 95 resources map to their own real, specifically-documented concept page. 24 are real, narrower scopes of a documented parent -- almost entirely the region_*/zone_* pattern (a regional or zonal resource is, by Google's own documentation, explicitly the same real concept as its global counterpart, scoped narrower) -- sourced from that counterpart, not skipped. 0 genuine skips this provider. Real, verified finding: google_compute_rollout_plan initially looked like a possible skip (only a bare REST API listing turned up at first) -- a second, more targeted search found real explanatory content (rollout waves by zone/region for VM Extension Manager) before concluding it was undocumented, matching the ticket's own 'verified by looking, not assumed' bar. Several other resources (cross_site_network, wire_group, storage_pool, future_reservation, instance_group_manager_resize_request, global_vm_extension_policy, network_edge_security_service, region_composite_health_check/health_aggregation_policy/health_source, organization_security_policy) are genuinely recent GCP features verified live via WebSearch rather than assumed from general Compute Engine knowledge, the same discipline applied to Kubernetes's own newer APIs. No paid API used.

last_migration.stopped_at: Batch 2 (this update): the 14 families with zero coverage after batch 1 (beyondcorp, config, pubsub, dataform, developerconnect, lustre, memcache, cloudkms, artifactregistry, managedkafka, bigqueryconnection, firestore, storagebatchoperations, recaptchaenterprise) fully hand-authored, 273 real gap fields (re-verified live against the actual current schema -- the real count drifted from batch 1's own 253 estimate, since the underlying schema is live-fetched), each two-search-verified against its own real API reference (e.g. Managed Lustre/Pub-Sub SMTs/Dataform/DeveloperConnect Insights docs). Cumulative real totals: 10366 of 26960 gap fields (38.4%) now carry AI-authored text, tagged by provenance -- source=ai-individual 334 fields (61 from batch 1's 15 families + 273 from batch 2's 14 families, 29 families fully complete, 0 remaining in any of them), source=ai-dictionary 10032 fields (67 families partially covered via the common-field dictionaries, unchanged since batch 1). 16594 fields remain, concentrated in a few large families: google_dlp (1643 remain), google_aiplatform (3255 remain), google_dialogflow (1132 remain), google_ces (602 remain), google_clouddeploy (857 remain), google_container (804 remain) -- clouddeploy/container still have only the generic AIP sweep, no family-specific dictionary built yet, real next targets. Every one of GCP's 96 gapped families now has at least some real coverage; none are fully untouched. Azure side: see azure/manifest.json's own last_migration, now far more complete (92.7% of its own gap) after this same batch's dictionary-expansion and small-family work. All 656 new GCP resource types (and Azure's 993) still need Phase C's real, live-researched intros -- explicitly held for after Phase B completes, per the founder's own instruction not to interleave the two.
